Triage: lands in area:ai · domain:ui · Bug · p1 · pm:queue · size S; rationale: the user's model pick is silently dropped after every answer, and the next question runs on the default model (`effectiveModelId = selectedModelId ?? defaultModelId`). The user is not told, the answer quality changes, and a cheaper pick is charged at the default's multiplier. That is a silent lost setting with a billing effect, so p1 by the silent-lost-update rule. Seen on 19.0.0-next.0, so it matters before 19.0 final. Recorded 2026-11-27T06:15Z.

repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibxaAB2c4Epy2EEZxDf

Closed by PR #38106, merged 2026-11-28T03:09Z as `bbe4258649c1ea8492364413c0669f47140f7707` through the merge queue (landing 7232612165, L1-c ACCEPT 7232599853 at head `eb2e26d3`).

What shipped: the composer's `handleSubmit` (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/elements/prompt-input.tsx`) clears only its own message field instead of calling `form.reset()`, so the model picker (a Radix `Select` in the same form) no longer answers the reset by writing the default model back. A picked model now stays picked for every later send. Pinned in `ChatbotEnhanced.modelPicker-11865.test.tsx` through the real form submit, with a CONTROL row and an ablation. `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` patch changeset.

Carried note: `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` :371 and :560 still say "form.reset clears the box"; whichever of #37861 or #38102 lands next rewords them to "clears its message field".
